_note: v2.8 plan 69 K8 (no-model lane). Host fact: a swipe added out of band (another extension pushing to chat[n].swipes and swipe_info without changing swipe_id or mes, then saveChat) emits no event and leaves the shown text alone; fingerprints hash mes, not swipes (runtime/fingerprints.ts). Expected outcome: no boundary and no rollback, before or after the next boundary. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-69-k8-swipe-append.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice. Also v2.8 69 K5: inline hosts sit beside .mes_text and assert-player-clean (which now sweeps .mes_text for SO nodes) finds nothing.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error('the sandbox chat still holds ' + ctx.chat.length + ' message(s)'); return { cleared: true };

steps.eval: const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const last = ctx.chat.length - 1; if (ctx.chat[last]?.is_user !== false) throw new Error('setup: the last message is not Arin\'s reply'); const markRt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const ms = markRt.getEngineState(); globalThis.__k8 = { boundary: ms.boundary, last: ms.lastMessageId, length: SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length, recommits: globalThis.storyOrchestratorSpikes?.editReread?.stats().recommits ?? null }; return globalThis.__k8;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const id = ctx.chat.length - 1; const row = ctx.chat[id]; const shown = row.mes; row.swipes = Array.isArray(row.swipes) ? row.swipes : [row.mes]; row.swipe_info = Array.isArray(row.swipe_info) ? row.swipe_info : [{}]; row.swipe_id = typeof row.swipe_id === 'number' ? row.swipe_id : 0; row.swipes.push('An out-of-band alternative nobody shows.'); row.swipe_info.push({ send_date: row.send_date, extra: {} }); await ctx.saveChat(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); if (row.mes !== shown) throw new Error('the shown text changed'); return { swipes: row.swipes.length, swipeId: row.swipe_id };

const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getEngineState(); const k = globalThis.__k8; if (s.boundary !== k.boundary) throw new Error('the out-of-band swipe committed a boundary: ' + k.boundary + ' -> ' + s.boundary); return { boundary: s.boundary };
